test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Identify the **correct passive voice** form of the following sentence:

"Habits also have a powerful impact on our behaviors."

options.text: Our behaviors are powerfully impacted by habits.
A powerful impact is also had on our behaviors by habits.
Our behaviors have been impacted powerfully by habits.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Habits also have a powerful impact on our behaviors."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Identify the object "a powerful impact" and place it at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have" (simple present) to its passive form "is had" (is + past participle).
 
• Maintain the adverb "also" and the prepositional phrase "on our behaviors."
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "habits."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A powerful impact is also had on our behaviors by habits."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Our behaviors are powerfully impacted by habits." – This changes the noun "impact" into a verb, which alters the original sentence structure rather than performing a direct voice conversion of the verb "have."
 
• **Option 3: **"Our behaviors have been impacted powerfully by habits." – Incorrect tense (present perfect) and changes the main verb.
 
• **Option 4: **"Habits impact our behaviors powerfully." – This is still in the active voice and changes the original grammatical structure.
